description: JS Global Capital Limited was incorporated as a private limited company on 28 June 2000 and is a Trading Right Entitlement Certificate holder of the Pakistan Stock Exchange and a member of the Pakistan Mercantile Exchange. Its principal activities, in its own listing, are share brokerage, money market brokerage, forex brokerage, commodity brokerage, advisory, underwriting, book running and consultancy services, alongside investment in listed and unlisted equity and debt securities and reverse repurchase transactions. It describes itself as the largest broking and investment banking firm in Pakistan.
headOffice: The Center, 17th & 18th Floor, Plot No. 28, S.B.5, Abdullah Haroon Road, Karachi, Pakistan
